# Student Tracking Dashboard Concept

A clean dashboard can show how study time and quiz performance move together across 6 weeks. The strongest story here is a steady upward trend with a small dip in Week 5.

## Recommended Chart Set

### 1) Dual-Line Trend Chart
- X-axis: Week 1 to Week 6
- Left Y-axis: Study time (hours)
- Right Y-axis: Quiz score (%)
- Best for: Showing week-by-week progression and comparing momentum

### 2) Scatter Plot with Trendline
- X-axis: Study time (hours)
- Y-axis: Quiz score (%)
- Best for: Revealing the relationship between study time and score
- Add labels for each week to make the pattern easy to read

## Week-by-Week Data View

Week | Study Time | Quiz Score
--- | --- | ---
Week 1 | 6 hours | 72%
Week 2 | 8 hours | 75%
Week 3 | 7 hours | 78%
Week 4 | 10 hours | 84%
Week 5 | 9 hours | 82%
Week 6 | 11 hours | 88%

## Correlation Direction

- **Direction:** Positive
- **Strength:** Fairly strong
- **Interpretation:** As study time increases, quiz scores generally increase too

## Teacher Insights

- Higher study time is associated with better scores overall, especially from Weeks 4 to 6.
- Week 3 shows a strong score improvement even with slightly less study time, which may suggest efficient study habits.
- Week 5 dips slightly in both hours and score, so consistency may matter as much as total time.
- Week 6 is the best performance point, suggesting that 10+ hours of focused study may support stronger results.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build Chart] https://www.canva.com/
Action: [Button: Open Sheets] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/

## Sources

- Correlation concept reference: https://www.britannica.com/science/correlation-statistics
- Charting in spreadsheets: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/63824?hl=en
